address_space.protected_write_unlock: Bits marked P=Protected Write are writable only when CCCR.CCE = 1 AND CCCR.INIT = 1.
address_space.reserved_address_response: Access to reserved addresses sets IR.ARA + asserts m_can_aei_ara output.

register_map.name: Core Release Register
register_map.summary: REL/STEP/SUBSTEP/YEAR/MON/DAY (BCD coded; YEAR/MON/DAY set by synthesis generic).

register_map.name: Endian Register
register_map.summary: Endianness test value ETV[31:0].

register_map.name: Customer Register
register_map.summary: Optional customer-specific 32-bit register.

register_map.name: Data Bit Timing & Prescaler Register
register_map.summary: TDC enable bit + DBRP[4:0] + DTSEG1[4:0] + DTSEG2[3:0] + DSJW[3:0]; data-phase bit timing. Reset configures 500 kBit/s data phase with 8 MHz m_can_cclk.

register_map.name: Test Register
register_map.summary: SVAL/TXBNS + PVAL/TXBNP (Tx Buffer Number Started/Prepared) + RX (m_can_rx monitor) + TX[1:0] (Tx pin control) + LBCK (Loop Back Mode). Writable only when CCCR.TEST = 1.

register_map.name: RAM Watchdog
register_map.summary: WDV[7:0] (counter value) + WDC[7:0] (start value, 0 = disabled). Triggers IR.WDI on no READY response.

register_map.name: CC Control Register
register_map.summary: NISO/TXP/EFBI/PXHD/WMM/UTSU/BRSE/FDOE/TEST/DAR/MON/CSR/CSA/ASM/CCE/INIT. INIT = 1 at reset → SW initialization mode.

register_map.name: Nominal Bit Timing & Prescaler Register
register_map.summary: NSJW[6:0] + NBRP[8:0] + NTSEG1[7:0] + NTSEG2[6:0]; arbitration-phase bit timing. Reset configures 500 kBit/s with 8 MHz m_can_cclk.

register_map.name: Timestamp Counter Configuration
register_map.summary: TCP[3:0] prescaler + TSS[1:0] (00 = always 0, 01 = internal, 10 = external CAN FD timebase, 11 = same as 00).

register_map.name: Timestamp Counter Value
register_map.summary: 16-bit Timestamp Counter; write resets to 0 (when TSS = 01); wrap → IR.TSW.

register_map.name: Timeout Counter Configuration
register_map.summary: TOP[15:0] period + TOS[1:0] (00 continuous, 01 Tx Event FIFO, 10 Rx FIFO 0, 11 Rx FIFO 1) + ETOC enable.

register_map.name: Timeout Counter Value
register_map.summary: TOC[15:0] down counter; reach 0 → IR.TOO; preset via TOCC.TOP.

register_map.name: reserved (4 words)
register_map.summary: Reserved; read access triggers IR.ARA.

register_map.name: Error Counter Register
register_map.summary: CEL[7:0] error logging (reset on read of byte 2) + RP (receive error passive flag) + REC[6:0] + TEC[7:0].

register_map.name: Protocol Status Register
register_map.summary: TDCV[6:0] + PXE + RFDF + RBRS + RESI + DLEC[2:0] + BO + EW + EP + ACT[1:0] + LEC[2:0].

register_map.name: Transmitter Delay Compensation Register
register_map.summary: TDCO[6:0] SSP offset + TDCF[6:0] filter window (0..127 mtq each).

register_map.name: reserved (1 word)
register_map.summary: Reserved.

register_map.name: Interrupt Register
register_map.summary: 30 edge-sensitive interrupt flags (ARA, PED, PEA, WDI, BO, EW, EP, ELO, BEU, BEC, DRX, TOO, MRAF, TSW, TEFL, TEFF, TEFW, TEFN, TFE, TCF, TC, HPM, RF1L, RF1F, RF1W, RF1N, RF0L, RF0F, RF0W, RF0N). W1C — write 1 clears.

register_map.name: Interrupt Enable
register_map.summary: Per-flag enable bits matching IR; 1 = signal interrupt on flag set.

register_map.name: Interrupt Line Select
register_map.summary: Per-flag interrupt-line selector; 0 = m_can_int0, 1 = m_can_int1.

register_map.name: Interrupt Line Enable
register_map.summary: EINT1 + EINT0 (enable m_can_int1 / m_can_int0 lines respectively).

register_map.name: reserved (8 words)
register_map.summary: Reserved; ARA on access.

register_map.name: Global Filter Configuration
register_map.summary: ANFS[1:0] (non-matching standard frame action: FIFO0 / FIFO1 / Reject) + ANFE[1:0] (extended) + RRFS (reject remote standard) + RRFE (reject remote extended).

register_map.name: Standard ID Filter Configuration
register_map.summary: LSS[7:0] number of standard filter elements (0..128, >128 → 128) + FLSSA[15:2] 32-bit word start address.

register_map.name: Extended ID Filter Configuration
register_map.summary: LSE[6:0] number of extended filter elements (0..64, >64 → 64) + FLESA[15:2] start address.

register_map.name: reserved (1 word)
register_map.summary: Reserved.

register_map.name: Extended ID AND Mask
register_map.summary: EIDM[28:0]; ANDed with received 29-bit ID before filter (J1939 mask). Reset all-1 = mask inactive.

register_map.name: High Priority Message Status
register_map.summary: FLST (filter list, 0 = std / 1 = ext) + FIDX[6:0] (filter index) + MSI[1:0] (00 no FIFO, 01 lost, 10 in FIFO0, 11 in FIFO1) + BIDX[5:0].

register_map.name: New Data 1
register_map.summary: ND[31:0] new data flags for Rx Buffers 0..31; cleared by writing 1.

register_map.name: New Data 2
register_map.summary: ND[63:32] new data flags for Rx Buffers 32..63.

register_map.name: Rx FIFO 0 Configuration
register_map.summary: F0OM (overwrite mode) + F0WM[6:0] (watermark) + F0S[6:0] (size 0..64) + F0SA[15:2] (start address).

register_map.name: Rx FIFO 0 Status
register_map.summary: RF0L (msg lost) + F0F (full) + F0PI[5:0] (put index) + F0GI[5:0] (get index) + F0FL[6:0] (fill level).

register_map.name: Rx FIFO 0 Acknowledge
register_map.summary: F0AI[5:0] FIFO ack index; M_CAN updates F0GI = F0AI + 1.

register_map.name: Rx Buffer Configuration
register_map.summary: RBSA[15:2] Rx Buffer section start address (each filter element with SFEC/EFEC=111 maps an Rx Buffer at RBSA + SFID2/EFID2[5:0] × element size).

register_map.name: Rx FIFO 1 Configuration
register_map.summary: Same shape as RXF0C: F1OM + F1WM[6:0] + F1S[6:0] + F1SA[15:2].

register_map.name: Rx FIFO 1 Status
register_map.summary: DMS[1:0] (Debug Message Status: 00 idle, 01 A, 10 A+B, 11 A+B+C) + RF1L + F1F + F1PI + F1GI + F1FL.

register_map.name: Rx Buffer / FIFO Element Size Configuration
Tx Buffer Configuration
register_map.summary: TFQM (Tx FIFO/Queue mode: 0 FIFO / 1 Queue) + TFQS[5:0] (FIFO/Queue size) + NDTB[5:0] (number of dedicated Tx Buffers) + TBSA[15:2] (Tx Buffer section start).

register_map.name: Tx FIFO/Queue Status
register_map.summary: TFQF (full) + TFQPI[4:0] (put index) + TFGI[4:0] (get index) + TFFL[5:0] (free level).

register_map.name: Tx Buffer Element Size Configuration
register_map.summary: TBDS[2:0] (Tx Buffer data size, same encoding as RXESC).

register_map.name: Tx Buffer Request Pending
register_map.summary: TRP[31:0] per-buffer transmission request pending (read-only).

register_map.name: Tx Buffer Add Request
register_map.summary: AR[31:0] host writes 1 to add Tx request for Buffer n (writable only when CCCR.CCE = 0).

register_map.name: Tx Buffer Cancellation Request
register_map.summary: CR[31:0] host writes 1 to cancel Buffer n (dedicated + Queue only, not FIFO).

register_map.name: Tx Buffer Transmission Occurred
register_map.summary: TO[31:0] per-buffer transmission completed.

register_map.name: Tx Buffer Cancellation Finished
register_map.summary: CF[31:0] per-buffer cancellation finished.

register_map.name: Tx Buffer Transmission Interrupt Enable
register_map.summary: TIE[31:0] enables IR.TC contribution for each buffer.

register_map.name: Tx Buffer Cancellation Finished Interrupt Enable
register_map.summary: CFIE[31:0] enables IR.TCF contribution for each buffer.

register_map.name: reserved (2 words)
register_map.summary: Reserved.

register_map.name: Tx Event FIFO Configuration
register_map.summary: EFWM[5:0] (watermark) + EFS[5:0] (size 0..32) + EFSA[15:2] (start address).

register_map.name: Tx Event FIFO Status
register_map.summary: TEFL (lost) + EFF (full) + EFPI[4:0] + EFGI[4:0] + EFFL[5:0].

register_map.name: Tx Event FIFO Acknowledge
register_map.summary: EFAI[4:0]; M_CAN sets EFGI = EFAI+1.

register_map.name: reserved (65 words)
register_map.summary: Reserved.

cccr_bit_breakdown.NISO[15]: 0 = ISO 11898-1:2015 CAN FD; 1 = Bosch CAN FD V1.0 (legacy). Reserved + reads 0 when iso_only_g = 1.
cccr_bit_breakdown.TXP[14]: 0 = no transmit pause; 1 = pause 2 CAN bit times between own transmissions.
cccr_bit_breakdown.EFBI[13]: 0 = edge filtering disabled; 1 = 2 consecutive dominant tq required for hard sync.
cccr_bit_breakdown.PXHD[12]: 0 = protocol exception handling enabled; 1 = disabled (treat as form error + error frame).
cccr_bit_breakdown.WMM[11]: 0 = 8-bit Message Marker; 1 = 16-bit Wide Message Marker (replaces 16-bit timestamps in Tx Event FIFO).
cccr_bit_breakdown.UTSU[10]: 0 = internal timestamping; 1 = external Timestamping Unit (TSU) per CiA 603. UTSU = 1 also enables Wide Message Markers. Fixed to 0 when connected_tsu_g = 0.
cccr_bit_breakdown.BRSE[9]: 0 = bit rate switching disabled; 1 = enabled (BRS evaluated). Only used when FDOE = 1.
cccr_bit_breakdown.FDOE[8]: 0 = FD operation disabled (FD frames raise error); 1 = FD operation enabled.
cccr_bit_breakdown.DAR[6]: 0 = automatic retransmission of failed/disturbed frames; 1 = disabled (for ISO 11898-1:2015 time-triggered).
cccr_bit_breakdown.MON[5]: 0 = normal; 1 = Bus Monitoring Mode (no dominant bits driven, no transmissions). Set only when CCE+INIT = 1.
cccr_bit_breakdown.CSR[4]: 0 = no clock-stop request; 1 = request clock stop (after pending Tx + bus idle, INIT + CSA go 1).
cccr_bit_breakdown.CSA[3]: 0 = no clock-stop acknowledge; 1 = M_CAN ready for power-down (clocks may be stopped). Read-only.
cccr_bit_breakdown.ASM[2]: 0 = normal CAN operation; 1 = Restricted Operation Mode active. Set only when CCE+INIT = 1.
cccr_bit_breakdown.CCE[1]: 0 = no CPU write access to protected configuration registers; 1 = write access (requires INIT = 1).
cccr_bit_breakdown.INIT[0]: 0 = normal operation; 1 = initialization. Reset = 1. CPU resets to 0 to enter normal operation after configuration.

psr_bit_breakdown.TDCV[22:16]: Transmitter Delay Compensation Value (0..127 mtq); SSP position in data phase.
psr_bit_breakdown.PXE[14]: Protocol Exception Event occurred since last read (byte 0).
psr_bit_breakdown.RFDF[13]: Last received message was CAN FD format (FDF = 1).
psr_bit_breakdown.RBRS[12]: Last received CAN FD message had BRS = 1.
psr_bit_breakdown.RESI[11]: Last received CAN FD message had ESI = 1.
psr_bit_breakdown.DLEC[10:8]: Data phase Last Error Code (only valid for FD frames with BRS = 1). Same encoding as LEC. Reset to 0 on successful FD-BRS transfer; reset to 7 on byte 0 read.
psr_bit_breakdown.BO[7]: Bus_Off status (1 = M_CAN is in Bus_Off).
psr_bit_breakdown.EW[6]: Warning status (1 = at least one error counter ≥ 96).
psr_bit_breakdown.ACT[4:3]: Activity: 00 sync, 01 idle, 10 receiver, 11 transmitter. Forced to 00 by Protocol Exception Event.
psr_bit_breakdown.LEC[2:0]: Arbitration-phase Last Error Code: 0 No, 1 Stuff, 2 Form, 3 Ack, 4 Bit1, 5 Bit0, 6 CRC, 7 NoChange (any read sets to 7).

ir_bit_breakdown.Bit 21 BEU: Bit Error Uncorrected (Message RAM read; sets CCCR.INIT)
ir_bit_breakdown.Bit 19 DRX: Message stored to Dedicated Rx Buffer
ir_bit_breakdown.Bit 17 MRAF: Message RAM Access Failure (Rx Handler or Tx Handler)

notes: M_CAN's register file is the architectural register map for CAN-FD operation. There is no protocol-level register map outside this controller — Classical CAN 2.0 is a wire-level protocol; M_CAN is the Bosch reference CAN-FD controller cited by ISO 11898-1:2015 derivatives. Each filter element, Rx Buffer, Tx Buffer, and Tx Event FIFO element resides in external Message RAM (not in this register address space).
